notes.title: Pandemic Bunny Second Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38612840/3cfe5581f2baba60dd47c2774b1f2b4ea02834f2.png[/img]

[b]Pandemic Bunny Update 2![/b]

Pandemic Bunny's Second Update has been released! 
The recent Pandemic Bunny update adds modifications and power ups to improve player experience!
Here is a list of what has changed in the update:
[list]
[*] Added mouse sensitivity slider in "Pause Menu"
[*] Added Power Ups into game (Power Up Cubes and Power Up notification)
[*] Balanced recoil (user experience)
[*] Modified gun damage (game balancing)
[/list]
We hope these changes improves your experience while playing Pandemic Bunny. 
Thank you so much for your support!

-Fluffy Bunny Studios

notes.title: Pandemic Bunny First Ever Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38612840/3cfe5581f2baba60dd47c2774b1f2b4ea02834f2.png[/img]

[b]Pandemic Bunny Update[/b]

You asked and we listened! 
The recent Pandemic Bunny update adds bugfixes and other modifications to improve player experience!
Here is a list of what has changed in the update:
[list]
[*] Fixed wall running/climbing issue (bugfix)
[*] Improved enemy AI response time (player experience)
[*] Enemies no longer clip and stack into each other (bugfix)
[*] More noticeable notification for when objectives change (player experience)
[*] Decreased grenade delay time (player experience)
[*] Increased gun damage (game balancing)
[*] Removed damage from sustained contact with enemy (game balancing)
[*] Increased damage from initial contact with enemy (game balancing)
[/list]
We hope these changes improves your experience while playing Pandemic Bunny. 
Thank you so much for your support!

-Fluffy Bunny Studios
